name: Build Pocket Rhythm
description: A watchable, interactive rhythm benchmark. Deterministic state checks cover motion, interaction and reset; visual quality requires separate inspection.
prompt: Build one self-contained pocket-rhythm.html titled Pocket Rhythm. Create a polished responsive canvas experience with 16 notes in four lanes, hit with A/S/D/F or touch; lane 0 initially has a hittable note. Include Pause/Resume, Reset, tempo control, visible elapsed time and score. Use inline HTML/CSS/JavaScript only: no network, dependencies, assets, audio autoplay or other files. Respect reduced motion by starting paused. Expose window.playground with reset(), step(dtSeconds), interact(lane=0), getState(). State includes time, score, particles (objects with finite x/y). Reset sets time and score to zero; stepping advances time and moves particles; interact(0) after reset increments score and visibly changes the scene. Keep simulations bounded and reproducible. Make controls keyboard/touch accessible. State checks do not certify rendered quality.

benchmark.intent: Observe interactive behavior and visual craft without confusing source checks with rendered proof.

graders.command: node -e 'const fs=require('"'"'fs'"'"'),vm=require('"'"'vm'"'"'),assert=require('"'"'assert'"'"');const html=fs.readFileSync('"'"'pocket-rhythm.html'"'"','"'"'utf8'"'"');const script=[...html.matchAll(/<script[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)].map(m=>m[1]).join('"'"'\n'"'"');const noop=()=>{};const element={getContext:()=>new Proxy({}, {get:()=>noop,set:()=>true}),addEventListener:noop,getBoundingClientRect:()=>({left:0,width:640})};const box={window:{},document:{querySelector:()=>element,getElementById:()=>element,addEventListener:noop,hidden:false},requestAnimationFrame:noop,matchMedia:()=>({matches:false}),console,Math};vm.createContext(box);vm.runInContext(script,box,{timeout:1000});vm.runInContext("const api=window.playground;api.reset();const before=api.getState();if(before.time!==0||before.score!==0||before.particles.length!==16)throw Error('"'"'reset state'"'"');for(let i=0;i<20;i++)api.step(.02);const after=api.getState();if(!(after.time>0)||JSON.stringify(before.particles)===JSON.stringify(after.particles))throw Error('"'"'no motion'"'"');api.reset();api.interact(0);if(!(api.getState().score>0))throw Error('"'"'no response'"'"');api.reset();if(api.getState().time!==0||api.getState().score!==0)throw Error('"'"'reset failed'"'"');",box,{timeout:1000});'
